blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The men who tried to steal the plane have been sentenced to death by firing squad.
exercises.why: In these instances the dative case answers the questions кому? чему? The question чему? (for inanimate nouns) is seldom used. The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case: *Я иду по коридору. Они едут по дороге.* По may mean "about", "around": *Он ходит по комнате. Они ездят по городу.* Notice also: по почте — by mail; по телефону — by phone; по радио — by radio; по делу — on business. The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion. After a verb of motion, к followed by a noun denoting a person indicates going to see that person at his place: *Я иду к полковнику.* Followed by a noun denoting… — DLI, Lessons 28 and 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: In these instances the dative case answers the questions кому? (DLI, Lessons 28 and 29)
